name: gnox-risk-management
description: Wizard-driven bootstrap and lifecycle management of controlled risk-management documentation sets for risk scenarios in the IT/IP space. Three orthogonal modular axes: compliance profiles (default: us-regulated-default), risk scenarios (default: AI-tooling ingress/egress payload audit; also print/physical-document egress), and audience stages (risk-management, QA/QC, engineering, executive). Documents mature generic → proposed → approved → implemented; approved finals are incorporated back into the skill's working knowledge. Regulatory/SOP language is fixed against drift by a pinned, hashed reference corpus (RR-005 register): the model is never the source of a clause — verbatim quotes with verifiable citations or explicit corpus-gap placeholders, exact-match re-verified at audit. Vendor-portable: platform facts carry provenance tiers and expiry triggers rather than being baked into the procedure.
